item.createpatina.patina_clock.tooltip.s: A tool for freely setting the _weathering_ and _waxing_ state of copper components.
item.createpatina.patina_clock.tooltip.b: Advances it to the next _weathering_ stage
Opens the _Weathering Interface_ to freely pick any _oxidation_ and _waxing_ state
gui.createpatina.patina_clock.title: Adjust Weathering State
createpatina.config.enable_portable_flui: If true, portable fluid interfaces with different weathering states can be matched to each other.
createpatina.config.collapse_patina_sets: If true, weathering variants will not be displayed separately. Hover your mouse over an unaffected item to browse its variants.
createpatina.config.oxidize_whole_fluid_: If true, natural weathering advances the entire fluid tank multiblock at once, so large tanks no longer split into separate weathered pieces.
createpatina.config.weather_whole_fluid_: Weather Whole Fluid Tank with Tools
If true, waxing, de-waxing or scraping a fluid tank block with a honeycomb, axe or sandpaper (by hand or with a deployer) applies to the entire tank multiblock at once, so large tanks stay intact.
createpatina.ponder.waxing.text_1: When passing through honey, the Air Flow would be able to wax items
createpatina.ponder.oxidation.text_2: Copper components would get oxidized and change their appearance
createpatina.ponder.oxidation.text_4: Honeycomb can be used to wax and protect the components
createpatina.ponder.display_link.text_1: Display Links can be used to visualise dynamic information
createpatina.ponder.display_link.text_3: ...then attach it to the block to read from
createpatina.ponder.display_link.text_4: Open the Interface to select and configure what is sent
createpatina.ponder.display_link.text_5: The display will now receive information from the link
createpatina.ponder.display_link.text_6: Not every block can act as a source
createpatina.ponder.display_link.text_7: Each compatible block provides unique information
createpatina.ponder.display_link.text_8: The Display Link can work with several different displays
createpatina.ponder.display_link_redston: When powered by Redstone, Display Links stop sending updates
Once unpowered, the Timer is reset and new info is sent immediately
Signals emitted from the source do not affect the Link
createpatina.ponder.encased_fluid_pipe.t: Copper Casing can be used to decorate Fluid Pipes
Aside from being concealed, Encased Pipes are locked into their connectivity state
It will no longer react to any neighbouring blocks being added or removed
createpatina.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.head: Moving Fluids using Copper Pipes
createpatina.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text: Fluid Pipes can connect two or more fluid sources and targets
Using a wrench, a straight pipe segment can be given a window
Windowed pipes will not connect to any other adjacent pipe segments
Powered by Mechanical Pumps, the Pipes can transport Fluids
No fluid is being extracted at first
Once the flow connects them, the endpoints gradually transfer their contents
Thus, the Pipe blocks themselves never 'physically' contain any fluid
createpatina.ponder.fluid_pipe_interacti: Endpoints of a pipe network can interact with a variety of blocks
Any block with fluid storage capabilities can be filled or drained
Source blocks right in front of an open end can be picked up...
...while spilling into empty spaces can create fluid sources
Pipes can also extract fluids from a handful of other blocks directly
createpatina.ponder.fluid_tank_sizes.tex: Fluid Tanks can be combined to increase the total capacity
Their base square can be up to 3 blocks wide...
...and grow in height by more than 30 additional layers
Using a Wrench, a tanks' window can be toggled
createpatina.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.t: Fluid Tanks can be used to store large amounts of fluid
Pipe networks can push and pull fluids from any side
The contained fluid can be measured by a Comparator
However, in Survival Mode Fluids cannot be added or taken manually
You can use Basins, Item Drains and Spouts to drain or fill fluid containing items
createpatina.ponder.hose_pulley.header: Source Filling and Draining using Hose Pulleys
createpatina.ponder.hose_pulley.text_1: Hose Pulleys can be used to fill or drain large bodies of Fluid
createpatina.ponder.hose_pulley.text_2: With the Kinetic Input, the height of the pulleys' hose can be controlled
createpatina.ponder.hose_pulley.text_3: The Pulley retracts while the input rotation is inverted
createpatina.ponder.hose_pulley.text_4: On the opposite side, pipes can be connected
createpatina.ponder.hose_pulley.text_5: Attached pipe networks can either provide fluid to the hose...
createpatina.ponder.hose_pulley.text_6: ...or pull from it, draining the pool instead
createpatina.ponder.hose_pulley.text_7: Fill and Drain speed of the pulley depends entirely on the fluid networks' throughput
createpatina.ponder.hose_pulley_infinite: Passively Filling and Draining large bodies of Fluid
When deploying the Hose Pulley into a large enough ocean...
It will provide/dispose fluids without affecting the source
Pipe networks can limitlessly take fluids from/to such pulleys
createpatina.ponder.hose_pulley_level.he: Fill and Drain level of Hose Pulleys
createpatina.ponder.hose_pulley_level.te: While fully retracted, the Hose Pulley cannot operate
Draining runs from top to bottom
The surface level will end up just below where the hose ends
Filling runs from bottom to top
The filled pool will not grow beyond the layer above the hose end
createpatina.ponder.item_drain.header: Emptying Fluid Containers using Item Drains
createpatina.ponder.item_drain.text_1: Item Drains can extract fluids from items
createpatina.ponder.item_drain.text_2: Right-click it to pour fluids from your held item into it
createpatina.ponder.item_drain.text_3: When items are inserted from the side...
createpatina.ponder.item_drain.text_4: ...they roll across, emptying out their contained fluid
createpatina.ponder.item_drain.text_5: Pipe Networks can now pull the fluid from the drains' internal buffer
createpatina.ponder.mechanical_pump_flow: Mechanical Pumps govern the flow of their attached pipe networks
Their arrow indicates the direction of flow
The network behind is now pulling fluids...
...while the network in front is transferring it outward
The pumps direction is unaffected by the input rotation
Instead, a Wrench can be used to reverse the direction
createpatina.ponder.mechanical_pump_spee: Regardless of speed, Mechanical Pumps affect pipes connected up to 16 blocks away
Speeding up the input rotation changes the speed of flow propagation...
...and the speed at which fluids are transferred
Pumps can combine their throughputs within shared pipe networks
Ensure that all of them are facing in the same direction
createpatina.ponder.portable_fluid_inter: Fluid Tanks on moving contraptions cannot be accessed by any pipes
This component can interact with fluid tanks without the need to stop the contraption
Place a second one with a gap of 1 or 2 blocks inbetween
Whenever they pass by each other, they will engage in a connection
While engaged, the stationary interface will represent ALL Tanks on the contraption
After no contents have been exchanged for a while, the contraption will continue on its way
createpatina.ponder.portable_storage_int: Redstone power will prevent the stationary interface from engaging
createpatina.ponder.smart_pipe.header: Controlling Fluid flow using Smart Pipes
createpatina.ponder.smart_pipe.text_1: Smart pipes can help control flows by fluid type
createpatina.ponder.smart_pipe.text_2: When placed directly at the source, they can specify the type of fluid to extract
createpatina.ponder.smart_pipe.text_3: Simply Right-Click their filter slot with any item containing the desired fluid
createpatina.ponder.smart_pipe.text_4: When placed further down a pipe network, smart pipes will only let matching fluids continue
createpatina.ponder.spout_filling.text_1: The Spout can fill fluid holding items provided beneath it
createpatina.ponder.spout_filling.text_2: The content of a Spout cannot be accessed manually
createpatina.ponder.spout_filling.text_3: Instead, Pipes can be used to supply it with fluids
createpatina.ponder.spout_filling.text_4: The Input items can be placed on a Depot under the Spout
createpatina.ponder.spout_filling.text_5: When items are provided on a belt...
createpatina.ponder.spout_filling.text_6: The Spout will hold and process them automatically
createpatina.ponder.steam_engine.text_1: Steam Engines can be placed on a Fluid Tank
createpatina.ponder.steam_engine.text_2: Clicking the engine with a Shaft creates the Kinetic Output
createpatina.ponder.steam_engine.text_3: With sufficient Heat, Water and Boiler space...
createpatina.ponder.steam_engine.text_5: The minimal setup requires 4 Fluid Tanks
createpatina.ponder.steam_engine.text_6: With the help of Blaze Burners, the power output can be increased
createpatina.ponder.steam_engine.text_7: Higher power levels require more Water, Size and Heat
createpatina.ponder.steam_engine.text_8: The boiler's current power level can be inspected with Engineer's Goggles
createpatina.ponder.steam_engine.text_9: With each added power level, an additional Engine can output at full capacity
createpatina.ponder.steam_whistle.text_1: Steam Whistles can be placed on a Fluid Tank
createpatina.ponder.steam_whistle.text_2: If the tank receives sufficient heat...
createpatina.ponder.steam_whistle.text_3: ...the Whistle will play a note when activated
createpatina.ponder.steam_whistle.text_4: Use a Whistle item on the block to lower its pitch
createpatina.ponder.steam_whistle.text_5: Cycle between three different octaves using a Wrench
createpatina.ponder.steam_whistle.text_6: Engineer's Goggles can help to find out the current pitch of a Whistle
createpatina.ponder.stock_link.header: Logistics Networks and the Stock Link
createpatina.ponder.stock_link.text_1: When placed, Stock Links create a new stock network
createpatina.ponder.stock_link.text_2: Right-click an existing link before placing it to bind them
createpatina.ponder.stock_link.text_3: Stock-linked packagers make their inventory available to the network
createpatina.ponder.stock_link.text_4: Other components on the network can now find and request their items
createpatina.ponder.stock_link.text_5: On request, items from the inventories will be placed into packages
createpatina.ponder.stock_link.text_6: Stock Link signals have unlimited range, but packages require transportation
createpatina.ponder.stock_link.text_7: Full redstone power will stop a link from broadcasting
createpatina.ponder.stock_link.text_8: Analog power lowers the priority of a link, causing others to act first
createpatina.ponder.table_cloth.text_1: Table cloths can be used to display items
createpatina.ponder.table_cloth.text_10: When checking out at the cashier, the bought items will be placed into a package
createpatina.ponder.table_cloth.text_11: From there, they can be transported to the shop front
createpatina.ponder.table_cloth.text_12: The payments will be stored inside the stock ticker block
createpatina.ponder.table_cloth.text_2: With the help of a logistics system, they can also be used to sell items
createpatina.ponder.table_cloth.text_3: Start with the shop's inventory, a Packager and Stock link
createpatina.ponder.table_cloth.text_4: Bind a Stock ticker to the link and place it in the shop
createpatina.ponder.table_cloth.text_5: Employ a mob or blaze burner as the shop keeper
createpatina.ponder.table_cloth.text_6: Fill the shop inventory with items to be sold
createpatina.ponder.table_cloth.text_7: To create a new trade, interact with the shop keeper while holding a table cloth
createpatina.ponder.table_cloth.text_8: Once placed, set a price in the item slot on the side
createpatina.ponder.table_cloth.text_9: Other players can now interact with the shop
createpatina.ponder.valve_pipe.text_1: Valve pipes help control fluids propagating through pipe networks
createpatina.ponder.valve_pipe.text_2: Their shaft input controls whether fluid is currently allowed through
createpatina.ponder.valve_pipe.text_3: Given Rotational Force in the opening direction, the valve will open up
createpatina.ponder.valve_pipe.text_4: It can be closed again by reversing the input rotation
createpatina.config.weather_whole_fluid_: If true, waxing, de-waxing or scraping a fluid tank block with a honeycomb, axe or sandpaper (by hand or with a deployer) applies to the entire tank multiblock at once, so large tanks stay intact. Adjusting a fluid tank's weathering state with the Patina Clock applies to the whole multiblock as well.
